 As a senior technical contributor on the Optical Systems Performance (OSP) Team, the Optical Systems Engineer advances end-to-end optical fiber sensing architectures and system designs spanning coherent modems, optical line systems, telemetry, signal processing, analytics, and application interfaces. The role applies theoretical and experimental optical engineering expertise to current and next-generation platforms, helping translate customer and business needs into integrated sensing system designs.
 How you will make an impact: 
 Own end-to-end optical fiber sensing architectures within the OSP team, translating customer and business needs into system requirements, architecture decisions, interface definitions, performance budgets, and technical roadmaps.
 Lead the design and integration of sensing solutions across coherent modems, optical line systems, embedded telemetry, timing and synchronization, data transport, signal processing, analytics, and application interfaces.
 Define sensing performance metrics and system specifications, develop link and noise budgets, identify key trade-offs, and validate designs through analytical modeling, numerical simulation, laboratory experiments, and field trials.
 Provide technical leadership from concept through implementation, verification, deployment, and lifecycle support, including design reviews, risk management, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex cross-domain issues.
 Develop and apply optical engineering expertise in fiber propagation, coherent detection, optical amplification, optical switching, link engineering, impairments, and measurement science to ensure sensing functions coexist with communications performance.
 Plan and execute laboratory and field investigations of modem-based and line-system-based sensing, including experimental design, instrumentation, data acquisition, signal analysis, performance characterization, and interpretation of results.
 Collaborate with hardware, modem, software, systems, product line management, solutions engineering, services, and customer teams to drive architecture alignment, integration priorities, demonstrations, and deployment readiness.
 The must haves : 
 Education: Graduate or post-graduate degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline, with application of optical engineering to communications, sensing, or complex photonic systems.
 Experience: 5+ years of experience with optical fiber sensing principles, signal processing, data analysis, and performance characterization, with the ability to connect physical phenomena to system-level requirements and observed measurements.
 Demonstrated ownership of complex system designs through requirements definition, architecture, modeling, prototyping, verification, integration, optimization, and deployment.
 Application of theoretical knowledge of fiber-optic propagation, coherent optical systems, noise and impairments, optical amplification, optical switching, polarization effects, and digital communications.
 Application of experimental optical engineering skills, including laboratory setup design, optical alignment and handling, calibration, uncertainty analysis, and use of oscilloscopes, signal generators, optical power meters, spectrum analyzers, polarization-control equipment, and related test instrumentation in an ESD-protected environment.
 Utilization of MATLAB and Python for development of models, analysis workflows, and reusable engineering tools.
 Proven ability to debug ambiguous, multidisciplinary system issues, make technical decisions with incomplete information, and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Nice to haves : 
 Education : Advanced degree with research or industry experience in optical communications, distributed fiber-optic sensing, coherent sensing, photonics, or a related discipline.
 5+ Years experience architecting sensing solutions that use coherent transponders or optical line-system telemetry, including timing, synchronization, data export, signal processing, and analytics.
 5+ Years experience with laboratory or field trials, customer demonstrations, network planning, optical modeling tools, or deployment of sensing functions over operational telecom fiber.
 Knowledge of distributed acoustic, phase, strain, vibration, or environmental sensing techniques and their implementation or coexistence in optical line systems.
 Familiarity with embedded systems, telemetry pipelines, microservice architectures, cloud or edge analytics, APIs, and distributed-system optimization.
 Experience contributing to technical publications, patents, industry standards, or cross-functional product roadmaps.
 Experience applying LLMs and generative AI to engineering workflows, including technical research, data analysis, software development, automation, and validation of AI-generated outputs.

 Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.
 The role
 You own some of our most important enterprise relationships: a book built to $2–3M a year, anchored by at least one client worth $1M+. You're the senior strategic partner to the client's marketing leadership, often across several business units, and the reason the account stays and grows.
 This isn't a people-management role. You coach others and may guide an Associate AEO Marketing Director on your anchor account, but your impact is the strength, health and growth of your book. Some of these roles are tied to a city so you can work in person with key clients.
 On our enterprise accounts, AEO Marketing Directors own the client relationship, the strategic roadmap and the account's growth. AEO Program Directors lead the dedicated team that delivers the work, and work with the client every week alongside you.

 The strategic roadmap for each account: priorities, the program, and how it ties to the client's revenue goals.

 Renewals and expansion across business units and channels, including complex, multi-line negotiations.
 Book margin, with the AEO Program Director: scope, pricing and changes.
 Enterprise pursuits in your industry, from pitch to signed contract to handover into delivery.
 Account health. You spot risk early and lead the recovery.
 What you bring
 10+ years of client-facing strategy or account leadership at an agency or consultancy.
 Personal ownership of $1M+ enterprise relationships, including renewals and expansions you drove.
 Presence with VP and C-level clients, and the strategic depth to advise them, not just report to them.
 Strong command of B2B marketing channels and how AI search is changing buyer discovery.
 Bonus: depth in one of our industries, such as financial services, higher education, or HR and payroll technology.

 Base salary $120k–$145k depending on experience and location

 Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond . We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments. 
 When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades. 
 AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it. 
 This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

 The Accounts Payable Specialist is responsible for day-to-day AP processing with added scope, complexity, and independence. This role builds on core AP experience and focuses on resolving more involved issues, supporting process consistency across the team, and working with a broader set of internal and external contacts. The Specialist also plays a hands-on role in supporting the integrity of financial data through accurate processing, reconciliation, and documentation.
 What You Do 
 Process accounts payable bills accurately and on schedule, including more complex or exception-based transactions.
 Collaborate with business unit and department leaders to validate coding, resolve discrepancies, and confirm approval flows.
 Take the lead on vendor issue resolution, including follow-ups on missing or disputed items.
 Analyze AP data to help identify recurring issues, process gaps, or opportunities to improve efficiency.

The Opportunity
 Position Summary   
 As an Associate at Egon Zehnder, you will play a pivotal role in partnering with our Consultants and Partners in delivering exceptional service and results to clients. You will engage in various aspects of executive search and advisory projects, contributing to the identification and assessment of top executive talent across multiple industries and developing your skills in market and candidate outreach. Your analytical skills and proactive approach will enable you to manage complex client engagements, ensuring that projects are executed efficiently and effectively. This position is ideal for individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and are passionate about senior talent acquisition and development. Your contributions will directly impact client success and business growth.
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities  
 Search Execution: Collaborate with Consultants/Partners to execute complex C-suite executive and board search assignments for clients with an emphasis on candidate research, candidate pool development and outreach.
 Project Management: Manage multiple client engagements efficiently, demonstrating strong project management skills to ensure timely and high-quality delivery of client needs. Ensure relevant information is captured in our database and prepare client update reports.
 Research and Analysis: Conduct comprehensive business, industry, and candidate research utilizing internal databases and external resources. Provide insightful market/candidate analysis and search strategies to present the best candidates to our clients for any given assignment.
 Business Development: Collaborate with Consultants to prepare high-quality marketing presentations and calibration profiles. Engage in business development activities to cultivate key accounts and identify new opportunities.
 Knowledge Management and Technology: Contribute to the Firm’s knowledge management initiatives by sharing best practices, developing industry expertise, and recording relevant information to enhance internal resources. Master and proactively engage with AI and technology as an enabler. Use all relevant internal and external resources, applications, and tools for leveraging own time and focus on high-value add work.
 Relationship Building and Mentorship: Foster effective relationships with team members across multiple offices and geographies, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration. Apprentice and mentor junior colleagues, when appropriate, throughout onboarding and their professional career progression. 
 Minimum Qualifications  
 A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required; an MBA or other advanced degree is preferred.
 5-10+ years of work experience in professional services (executive search, consulting, agency etc.), corporate talent acquisition/management, investment research, market research, or business-oriented research.
 Demonstrated experience in tackling complex problems with a strategic and analytical approach.
 Ability to persistently pursue solutions and navigate obstacles, ensuring that challenges are addressed thoroughly and effectively.
 A proactive mindset that embraces challenges and a commitment to seeing tasks through to completion, regardless of difficulties encountered.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to create clear, concise, and compelling presentations and reports tailored to diverse audiences.
 Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring adherence to deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards.
 Advanced proficiency in MS Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and experience with CRM or database systems for effective data management.
 Demonstrated experience in engaging and communicating effectively with senior executives.
 Preferred Qualifications  
 Familiarity with leveraging technologies, including GenAI and other digital tools, to enhance processes. Ability to utilize technology as an enabler to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and drive innovative solutions.
 Experience in/strong familiarity with of one of the following industries: Consumer, Financial Services, Industrial, Technology/Communications, Services.
 About Egon Zehnder 
 Egon Zehnder is the world’s preeminent leadership advisory firm, inspiring leaders to navigate complex questions with human answers. We help organizations get to the heart of their leadership challenges and offer honest feedback and insights to help leaders realize their true being and purpose.
 We are built on a foundation that supports partnership in the truest sense of the word and aligns our interests with the interests of our clients. Our 560 consultants across 64 offices and 36 countries are former industry and functional leaders who collaborate seamlessly across geographies, industries and functions to deliver the full power of the Firm to every client, every time.
 We partner closely with public and private corporations, family-owned enterprises, and non-profit and government agencies to provide executive search, leadership solutions, CEO search and succession, and board advisory.
 We believe that together we can transform people, organizations and the world through leadership.
 Due to high volume, we will only be contacting applicants who meet all of the minimum requirements listed in the job description. Only those applicants who align most closely with our minimum and preferred qualifications will be contacted for an interview. The Recruiting team at Egon Zehnder will retain your application materials and may contact you regarding future opportunities. 
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Sommaire du poste   
 En tant qu’associé chez Egon Zehnder, vous jouerez un rôle central en collaborant avec nos consultants et nos associés afin d’offrir un service et des résultats exceptionnels à nos clients. Vous participerez à divers aspects des projets de recherche de cadres supérieurs et de conseil, en contribuant à l’identification et à l’évaluation des meilleurs talents de haut niveau dans de nombreux secteurs d’activité, tout en développant vos compétences en matière de prospection du marché et de prise de contact avec les candidats. Vos compétences analytiques et votre approche proactive vous permettront de gérer des mandats complexes auprès des clients, en veillant à ce que les projets soient menés à bien de manière efficace et efficiente. Ce poste est idéal pour les personnes qui s’épanouissent dans un environnement dynamique et axé sur le travail d’équipe, et qui sont passionnées par le recrutement et le développement de cadres supérieurs. Vos contributions auront un impact direct sur la réussite des clients et la croissance de l’entreprise.
 Tâches et responsabilités essentielles  
 Exécution des recherches : Collaborer avec les consultants et les partenaires pour mener à bien des mandats complexes de recherche de cadres supérieurs et de membres de conseils d’administration pour le compte de nos clients, en mettant l’accent sur la recherche de candidats, la constitution d’un bassin de candidats et la prise de contact.
 Gestion de projets : Gérer efficacement plusieurs mandats clients, en faisant preuve de solides compétences en gestion de projets afin de garantir une exécution rapide et de haute qualité des demandes des clients. S’assurer que les informations pertinentes sont saisies dans notre base de données et préparer des rapports d’avancement à l’intention des clients.
 Recherche et analyse : Effectuer des recherches approfondies sur les entreprises, les secteurs d’activité et les candidats à l’aide de bases de données internes et de ressources externes. Fournir des analyses pertinentes du marché et des candidats, ainsi que des stratégies de recherche, afin de présenter les meilleurs candidats à nos clients pour chaque mandat.
 Développement des affaires : Collaborer avec les consultants pour préparer des présentations marketing et des profils d’étalonnage de haute qualité. Participer à des activités de développement des affaires afin de cultiver les comptes clés et d’identifier de nouvelles occasions.
 Gestion des connaissances et technologie : Contribuer aux initiatives de gestion des connaissances du cabinet en partageant les pratiques exemplaires, en développant l’expertise sectorielle et en consignant les renseignements pertinents afin d’enrichir les ressources internes. Maîtriser l’IA et la technologie et les utiliser de manière proactive comme catalyseurs. Utiliser toutes les ressources, applications et outils internes et externes pertinents pour optimiser son temps et se concentrer sur les tâches à forte valeur ajoutée.
 Établissement de relations et mentorat : Entretenir des relations efficaces avec les membres de l’équipe répartis dans plusieurs bureaux et régions, en assurant une communication et une collaboration harmonieuses. Encadrer et conseiller les collègues moins expérimentés, le cas échéant, tout au long de leur intégration et de leur progression professionnelle.
 Qualifications minimales  
 Un baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent est requis; un MBA ou un autre diplôme d’études supérieures est un atout.
 De 5 à 10 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle dans les services professionnels (recrutement de cadres, consultation, agences, etc.), l’acquisition et la gestion des talents en entreprise, la recherche en investissement, les études de marché ou la recherche axée sur les affaires.
 Expérience avérée dans la résolution de problèmes complexes grâce à une approche stratégique et analytique.
 Capacité à rechercher sans relâche des solutions et à surmonter les obstacles, en veillant à ce que les défis soient relevés de manière approfondie et efficace.
 Esprit proactif, prêt à relever les défis, et engagement à mener les tâches à bien, quelles que soient les difficultés rencontrées.
 Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de créer des présentations et des rapports clairs, concis et convaincants, adaptés à divers publics.
 Solides compétences organisationnelles et capacité avérée à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément, en veillant au respect des échéances et au maintien de normes de qualité élevées.
 Maîtrise avancée de la suite MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) et expérience des systèmes de gestion de la relation client (CRM) ou des bases de données pour une gestion efficace des données.
 Expérience avérée dans l’interaction et la communication efficaces avec les cadres supérieurs.
 Qualifications privilégiées  
 Maîtrise de l’utilisation des technologies, notamment l’IA générative (GenAI) et d’autres outils numériques, pour optimiser les processus. Capacité à utiliser la technologie comme levier pour rationaliser les flux de travail, améliorer l’efficacité et favoriser l’émergence de solutions innovantes.
 Expérience ou solide connaissance de l’un des secteurs suivants : biens de consommation, services financiers, industrie, technologie/communications, services.
 À propos d’Egon Zehnder 
 Egon Zehnder est le plus important cabinet-conseil en leadership au monde, inspirant les dirigeants d’entreprise à résoudre des questions complexes avec des réponses humaines. Nous aidons les organisations à prendre le dessus sur leurs défis de leadership et leur offrons des commentaires et des idées honnêtes pour amener les dirigeants à réaliser leur plein potentiel tout en ciblant leurs objectifs.
 Nous nous appuyons sur une base qui soutient le partenariat au sens le plus pur et qui harmonise nos intérêts avec ceux de nos clients. Nos 560 consultants répartis dans 64 bureaux et 36 pays sont d’anciens dirigeants fonctionnels et sectoriels qui collaborent de façon transparente dans une multitude de régions, de secteurs d’activité et de fonctions afin de toujours offrir la pleine valeur de l’entreprise à chaque client.
 Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec des sociétés publiques et privées, des entreprises familiales et des agences à but non lucratif et gouvernementales pour fournir des services de recherche de cadres, des solutions de leadership, de recherche et de succession de PDG et de conseil d'administration.
 Nous croyons qu’ensemble, nous pouvons façonner un leadership qui transformera les gens, les entreprises et le monde.
 En raison du volume élevé de candidatures, nous communiquerons uniquement avec les candidats qui satisfont à toutes les exigences minimales énumérées dans la description de poste. Seuls les candidats qui correspondent le plus aux qualifications minimales et privilégiées seront convoqués pour une entrevue. L’équipe de recrutement d’Egon Zehnder conservera vos documents de candidature et pourrait communiquer avec vous au sujet de possibilités futures.

The Opportunity
 Flosum is looking for a visionary Salesforce Technical Business Analyst who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.
 This is not a maintenance role. You will own the product roadmap for the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies, global brands like Hilton, Cargill, Barry Callebaut, Cushman & Wakefield, and AARP. You will work directly with the CEO and engineering leadership to define and ship products that create entirely new categories within the Salesforce ecosystem.
 We are at an inflection point. AI-driven DevOps (powered by Agentforce), agent-aware governance, zero-trust security orchestration, and intelligent data lifecycle management are transforming the Salesforce landscape. We need a product leader who sees around corners, understands where this space is heading, and has the conviction and execution chops to get us there first.
 About Flosum
 Flosum is the only enterprise-grade DevOps, Data Backup & Archive, Trust Center, and Data Seeding platform built 100% native on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and the only native solution certified by Salesforce, we operate within the Salesforce trust boundary, which means zero data exposure, no third-party cloud processing, and full compliance with Salesforce security standards.
 Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. We compete against Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, and Salto, and we win because our native architecture delivers security, speed, and extensibility that external tools simply cannot match.
 We recently integrated Salesforce Agentforce into our platform, making Flosum the first and only Salesforce-native AI DevOps solution. This is just the beginning of what we plan to build.
 What You Will Own
 Product Vision & Strategy
 Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap across Flosum's five product lines: DevOps, Backup & Archive, Trust Center, Data Seeding, and DevOps for Veeva.
 Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors.
 Translate deep Salesforce platform knowledge (metadata architecture, deployment models, Agentforce, Data Cloud, multi-org environments) into product capabilities that enterprise customers will pay premium prices for.

 AI & Innovation

WANTED: One Hungry Closer Who's Sick Of Selling Other People's Dreams. 
 (Read this whole thing. If you quit halfway, we already have your answer.) 
 Most job ads read like they were written by HR. 
Bullet points. Buzzwords. 
A "competitive compensation package" that translates to "we'll pay you just enough to keep you from leaving, but never enough to actually win." 
 This isn't that.
 This is a letter. From us to you. About one of the most lopsided opportunities we've ever put in front of a salesperson and the rare, specific human being we're trying to find to fill it.
 If that human is you, you're going to feel it in your chest somewhere around paragraph nine.
 First — Who We Are. And Why It Matters. 
 We're Wealth Without Wall Street. 
 Russ Morgan and Joey Muré built this from scratch, not in a Manhattan glass tower, not with a hedge-fund pedigree, but by getting fed up watching hardworking business owners hand their financial futures to suit-wearing strangers who couldn't pick them out of a lineup.
 Together we've helped thousands of business owners, real estate investors, doctors, and high-earning professionals do what 99% of America has been brainwashed into believing is impossible:
 Generate passive income that exceeds their monthly expenses. 
 That's the whole game. That's what freedom actually looks like — not a 401(k) you can't touch until you're 65 and your knees are gone, but real cash flowing in every single month whether you work or not.
 We do it using the Infinite Banking Concept — the same wealth strategy quietly used by the richest families in America for over a century. We teach people to become their own bank. To recycle their capital. To stop renting money from institutions that profit off their ignorance.
 Russ and Joey have done it themselves. Over $50,000 per month in passive income. Co-authors of an Amazon bestseller. Hosts of one of the most respected podcasts in personal finance.
 This isn't theory. This is the real thing.
 Right now, we have more qualified people waving their hands than we can possibly talk to.
 That's where you come in.
 The Role: Business Developer. (Translation: The Person Who Decides Who Gets Free.) 
 Let us describe a typical day so you know exactly what you're signing up for.
 You wake up. You check your calendar. There are real, pre-qualified humans on it, people who registered for our workshops, devoured Russ and Joey's content, raised their hand, and said "I want a Passive Income Game Plan Session." 
 These aren't cold strangers. 
These aren't leads scraped off a list. 
These are people who already trust the brand, already believe the philosophy, and already know they're tired of the rat race.
 Your job is to pickup the phone, set appointments by making outbound calls and take inbound appointments.
Ask the kind of questions most salespeople are too soft to ask. 
Find out where they really are financially, emotionally, mentally. Diagnose whether IBC and our path is actually right for them.
 And if it is? You hand them the keys.
 You're not pitching. You're not pressuring. You're not chasing.
 You're the bridge between someone's current life — exhausted, overworked, financially fragile — and the version of their life where they sleep through the night because money is finally working for them instead of against them.
 That's the job.
 If that sounds like too much responsibility, the back button is right there.
 Who We Are NOT Looking For. 
 Let's save us both some time.
 We are not looking for the guy who calls himself a "closer" because he sold timeshares in Cabo for six months.
 We are not looking for the person who needs a six-week ramp, a personal coach, three resource Slack channels, and a "psychologically safe" environment to dial a phone.
 We are not looking for someone who's going to ghost on Friday afternoons because the surf is up.
 We are not looking for a salary chaser. If a guaranteed paycheck is what you're after, McDonald's is hiring. Go thrive.
 And we are definitely not looking for someone who can't speak from the heart about money, freedom, and the very real fear most Americans carry around about both. If you can't connect at the soul level, you can't sell this. Period.
 Who We ARE Looking For. 
 A killer. But a killer with a conscience.
 Someone who can sit across a Zoom screen from a stranger and — within ten minutes — have them admitting things they haven't told their spouse.
 Someone who's already a top performer somewhere else and is bored to tears selling SaaS, solar, or something else they couldn't care less about.
 Someone who reads Rich Dad Poor Dad , listens to BiggerPockets, follows Dave Ramsey just to argue with him, and already has an opinion about whole life insurance — even if that opinion needs updating.
 Someone with the spine to say "I don't think you're a fit. Here's why," and walk away from money on principle.
 Someone who treats every conversation like it's their last shot — because that's how the great ones do it.
 If you read those five paragraphs and felt seen, keep going.
 The Non-Negotiables.
 Proven sales background. Minimum 2+ years closing in a high-ticket, phone/Zoom-based environment. We don't care about your resume — we care about your numbers.
 25%+ close rate after probation. Below that, you're not the right fit and we'll part as friends.
 Full ownership of your pipeline. Nobody is going to chase you to follow up. The leads are there. The CRM is built. The systems work. You just have to work them. 
 Show up sharp every single day. This is a high-tempo environment. We move. We measure. We adjust.
 Live the message. If you don't believe building wealth outside the traditional system is possible, you cannot sell it. Period. Bonus points if you already own a whole life policy, have read Becoming Your Own Banker by Nelson Nash, or have personal experience with real estate investing or passive income.
 Stable, professional remote setup. High-speed internet, quiet environment, quality camera and mic. We're representing a premium brand on every single call.
 CRM discipline. You log notes the same day. You update statuses in real time. If "I forgot to update the CRM" is a phrase that comes out of your mouth more than twice, this won't work.
 Emotional intelligence over scripts. We'll give you frameworks. We will not give you a robot script to memorize. If you can't read a human, you can't sell here.
 Coachable ego. Strong opinions, loosely held. We promote killers who listen. We fire prima donnas who don't.
 A worldview that aligns. You believe people are responsible for their own freedom. You believe Wall Street is not the answer for most families. You believe in earning the right to be paid well — not waiting to be handed it.
 The Catch: 
 We get a lot of applications. 
Most won't make it past the first filter. 
We're not looking for a resume, we're looking for evidence. 
 A sales background that proves you can sit in the fire without flinching, a track record that doesn't need to be inflated, and a worldview that aligns with what we actually believe about money, freedom, and the responsibility of helping someone change their life.
 If that's you, apply. Right now. While you're feeling it.
 The Compensation. (Read This Slowly.) 
 We're going to lay this out plainly because we want you to do the math before you apply, not after.
 100% commission. Uncapped. No ceiling. No politics. 
 10% of cash collected on all Passive Income Lab Sales ($7,500 Price Point)
 20% of cash collected on all PIOS Sales ($1,000 Price Point)
 OTE for the people who actually do the work: $120K–$200K+ annually
 The top performers here aren't just closers. 
They're portfolio builders. 
Every month you close, you're stacking another stream of recurring income on top of what you closed last month. 
Twelve months in, you've got a book of business that pays you whether you take the call or not.
 Sound familiar?
 That's right. 
We pay you the same way we teach our clients to live. 
Passive income. Compounding. Freedom.
 If we wouldn't drink our own Kool-Aid with the people who sell our offer, we'd have no business selling it to anyone.
 What's In It For The Right Person. 
 Beyond the money?
 Mission that matters. You'll be the first conversation thousands of families ever have about real financial freedom. You'll be the one who makes them realize they've been lied to for thirty years, and you'll be the one who shows them the way out.
 Direct access to Russ Morgan and Joey Muré, two of the most generous, mission-driven, real-deal humans in this industry.
 Elite-level sales coaching from closers who've done eight figures in this exact niche.
 100% remote. From your kitchen. From Bali. From a coffee shop in Medellín. We don't care where the work happens. We care that the work happens.
 Pre-qualified, warm inbound leads — not cold lists, not scraped data, not random dials.
 A real product you can be proud of. No bait-and-switch. No fake scarcity. No "course that goes nowhere." A genuine pathway to freedom backed by a decade of results.

 The Senior CRM Specialist is a hands-on, technically strong CRM operator who builds, deploys, and maintains email campaigns and customer journeys in Adobe Experience Cloud for Level's clients. This is not a pure engineering role: we are looking for someone who understands why a journey exists, not just how to build it. They should bring a marketer's sense of the customer lifecycle to every build.
 About Level
 Level Agency is an AI-powered performance marketing agency built for brands ready to shatter yesterday’s wins.
 We help complex, high-consideration brands outperform their last result using AI, data science, creativity, and relentless iteration.
 We specialize in markets where the stakes are high and the journeys are complex — education, B2B technology, financial services, healthcare, CPG, ecommerce, and more. Our work spans the full performance ecosystem: media planning & buying, performance creative, SEO & AI search, CRM & automation, and advanced analytics.
 In 2025, Level acquired BAM Strategy — expanding our capabilities into digital experience, CRM strategy, personalization, and loyalty. The result is a fully integrated growth engine that connects acquisition to retention, media to lifecycle, and performance to long-term customer value.
 Today, our 250-person team operates fully remote across the U.S. and Canada, supporting 150+ ambitious brands.
 Your Role (and Impact)
 Sitting within Level's Martech & Analytics team, this person takes a brief and runs with it. They own their work from setup through deployment, make sound judgment calls without being told every step, and bring forward recommendations when something could work better. The ideal candidate is a self-directed, proven operator who can step into an existing instance, diagnose what is broken, and fix it with minimal oversight.
 Own the build, QA, and deployment of email campaigns in Adobe Campaign (Classic or Standard) and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer end to end, ensuring every send is accurate, on time, and on brand
 Translate briefs and journey maps into working builds, filling gaps with sound judgment and raising questions early when a brief is incomplete or a requirement won't work as written
 Configure audience targeting, personalization, and dynamic content within existing templates and data schemas to improve relevance and engagement
 Manage the send calendar, including scheduling, dependency sequencing, and deployment-readiness checks for rendering, links, suppression, and compliance (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, CASL)
 Configure and maintain multi-step, multi-channel journeys (email, plus SMS and push where in scope), implementing segmentation, flow control, and decision logic
 Run journey QA on logic, timing, and audience entry/exit conditions before activation, so issues are caught before they reach customers
 Audit existing campaign and journey builds, workflows, and data schemas, diagnose what is broken, redundant, or misconfigured, and fix it without disrupting live sends
 Recommend improvements to journey logic, segmentation, and program performance, explaining the marketing rationale as well as the technical approach
 Bring a proposed solution, not just the problem, when escalating structural or data-quality issues that require architecture-level decisions
 Communicate clearly with internal teams and client stakeholders, setting expectations, flagging risks, and explaining technical trade-offs in plain language
 Document builds and fixes so the team has a clean, reliable handoff trail
 Skills & Qualifications
 Must-Haves: 
 Hands-on production experience in Adobe Campaign (Classic or Standard) and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform
 A track record of owning CRM work end to end with minimal oversight; you are comfortable being the person who makes it work
 Proven ability to step into an existing instance built by others, diagnose problems, and repair prior configuration rather than only building greenfield
 Strong lifecycle marketing understanding: you can explain why a journey is designed a certain way and spot when it isn't serving the customer or the business
 Sound judgment on when to make a call yourself and when to escalate, with the confidence to push back on a brief that won't work
 Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
 Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email template troubleshooting and customization
 Working knowledge of email/SMS compliance regulations
 Preferred: 
 Hands-on experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (strongly preferred), such as Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio, AMPscript, and SQL query activities
 Experience with additional CRM and marketing automation platforms, such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Klaviyo, or Braze
 Experience with Adobe Experience Platform segments, schemas, and audience activation
 SQL or scripting (JavaScript) for workflow customization and troubleshooting
 Telecom or B2C subscription-industry CRM experience
 Agency-side or client-facing experience
 Education & Experience
 Must-Haves: 
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or 4 additional years of equivalent professional experience)
 5 to 8 years of hands-on CRM and lifecycle marketing experience, with significant production work in Adobe Experience Cloud email and journey platforms
 Preferred: 
 Adobe Certified Professional or Expert in Adobe Campaign or Adobe Journey Optimizer
 Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification (e.g., Email Specialist, Developer, or Consultant)
 Agency experience supporting CRM programs for multiple clients simultaneously
 AI Expectations
 At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work.
 You are expected to:
 Experiment continuously with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (e.g., draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets).
 Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together.
 Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process.
 Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine.
 AI is not a shortcut—it’s a skillset. You’re expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level.
 Our Core Values
 No Ego, All In 
We don't do "that's not my job." We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.
 Better Every Day 
We want the feedback, even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.
 Relentless for Results 
Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.
 Driven by Truth 
We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear, not just what is easy to say.
 Perks & Benefits
 At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.
 Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays

 À propos d’EDC 
 À EDC, nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l’étranger. En tant que société d’État à vocation financière, EDC propose des solutions financières innovantes et des conseils d’experts pour aider les entreprises à explorer de nouveaux marchés, à atténuer leurs risques et à se développer.
 Pourquoi vous joindre à EDC? 
 Collaborez avec une équipe diversifiée et expérimentée. Travaillez avec des professionnels talentueux qui mettent à profit leurs connaissances et leur expertise étendues pour favoriser la réussite.

Joignez-vous à une organisation reconnue pour son engagement en faveur de l’excellence, de la diversité et de la conciliation travail-famille.
 Profitez d’un programme d’avantages globaux : 
 Avantages sociaux flexibles – Notre programme vous permet de choisir la couverture qui répond à vos propres besoins, notamment sur le plan des soins médicaux et dentaires et de l’assurance vie.  Régime de retraite à cotisations déterminées – Assurez votre avenir grâce à notre généreux programme avec cotisations de contrepartie qui vous aide à épargner pour la retraite.
 Programme de congés annuels concurrentiel – Conciliez travail et vie personnelle grâce à notre programme de congés annuels concurrentiel, qui offre aux employés permanents quatre semaines de congés et deux jours de congés mobiles par année à leur embauche.
 Programmes de bien-être complets – Veillez à votre santé et à votre bonheur en profitant des initiatives de bien-être, de l’aide à la santé mentale et des programmes de conditionnement physique.
 Perfectionnement professionnel – Propulsez votre carrière grâce à des conférences, des formations linguistiques et des occasions d’apprentissage visant à appuyer votre développement et votre perfectionnement professionnel.
 Aperçu de l’équipe et du poste 
 Le Groupe des investissements d’EDC est un groupe d’investissements permanents dont les capitaux investis ou engagés s’élèvent à plus de quatre milliards de dollars. Nous réalisons des investissements autonomes et en partenariat avec d’autres investisseurs selon des conditions commerciales et des attentes en matière de rendement. EDC investit à la fois directement dans des entreprises canadiennes sur une base minoritaire et par l’entremise d’engagements auprès des fonds de capital-investissement canadiens et internationaux. Nous sommes des investisseurs à long terme qui exploitent les connaissances, les réseaux et les offres de produits d’EDC au profit des entreprises canadiennes et de leurs aspirations de croissance à l’échelle internationale.
 L’Équipe de gestion de portefeuille et d’analyse d’impact soutient la fonction d’investissement en mobilisant les données et les systèmes pour optimiser : i) les activités d’engagement sur le terrain; ii) l’efficacité de la gestion des investissements; iii) les retombées de nos stratégies de création de valeur; et iv) la gestion du capital. Comme il s’agit d’une nouvelle fonction, les personnes choisies contribueront à la constitution et à l’encadrement de l’équipe.
 Les personnes choisies possèderont au moins 3 ans d’expérience en matière de capital-investissement ou de capital-risque et disposeront donc : i) d’une connaissance approfondie de l’écosystème canadien du capital-investissement; ii) d’une expérience en analyse des investissements; iii) d’un savoir-faire solide en matière de données; et iv) d’une connaissance des catégories d’actifs, de leurs participants et des pratiques. 
 Principales responsabilités

 Contribuer à la gestion du portefeuille d’investissements, y compris surveiller le rendement du portefeuille de placements; analyser les risques et les performances, faire des prévisions et des rapprochements entre les différents systèmes d’information financière.
 Veiller à l’évaluation et à la valorisation continues des investissements individuels, ce qui implique d’entretenir des relations avec les responsables des investissements du portefeuille afin de fournir ou de coordonner un soutien à valeur ajoutée à leurs stratégies de croissance.
 Fournir des renseignements exploitables en améliorant les prévisions ainsi que l’analyse et les rapports relatifs au programme afin de suivre l’efficacité des stratégies de capital et de création de valeur.
 Agir comme membres de l’équipe enthousiastes à l’égard des données et de la technologie, qui élaborent des rapports, des tableaux de bord, des requêtes d’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des analyses afin d’apporter des optimisations axées sur les données au programme de gestion des risques.
 Soutenir l’amélioration de la gouvernance, des systèmes et des opérations en menant des projets spéciaux visant à redéfinir les processus, les rapports et les opérations. 
 Agir comme ressources clés auprès des membres de l’Équipe des investissements et être les intermédiaires auprès des Équipes de la technologie, de la gestion des risques, des finances et des rapports d’entreprise.
 Travailler en équipe – travailler en collaboration et de manière efficace avec la clientèle d’EDC et les diverses parties prenantes internes et externes. 
 Compétences et connaissances 
 Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication, la collaboration et le travail d’équipe, et crédibilité suffisante pour interagir avec des professionnels de l’investissement, du risque et des finances.
 Capacité à favoriser la communication entre les équipes techniques, des finances, de gestion des risques et des investissements.
 Expertise approfondie en matière d’analyse des investissements, de constitution de portefeuilles et de modélisation du capital.
 Savoir-faire en matière de données, soutenu par les technologies émergentes et l’IA.
 Bonne maîtrise des principes et des concepts de la comptabilité des investissements.
 Solides compétences techniques et en matière de données, y compris des compétences avancées dans l’utilisation d’Excel, la création de requêtes, la création de tableaux de bord (p. ex., Power BI) et l’IA.
 Critères de sélection 
 Associée ou associé : Au moins 3 années d’expérience pertinente dans le domaine du capital-investissement, du capital-risque ou de l’investissement dans les entreprises, et capacité avérée de prise en charge du rendement d’un portefeuille, d’analyse approfondie et d’innovation en matière de systèmes
 Associée principale ou associé principal : Au moins 5 années d’expérience pertinente dans le domaine du capital-investissement, du capital-risque ou de l’investissement dans les entreprises, et capacité avérée de prise en charge du rendement d’un portefeuille, d’analyse approfondie et d’innovation en matière de systèmes
 Atouts 
 Expérience au sein d’un investisseur institutionnel ou d’une caisse de retraite
 CFA, FRM, CAIA, CBV, ou MBA/MFIN, ou titre semblable
 Expertise des systèmes d’investissement et des plateformes de données sur les marchés privés (p. ex. Preqin, Capital IQ, PitchBook, eFront, Burgiss)
 Admissibilité 
 EDC s’engage à respecter les pratiques d’emploi équitables et la préférence sera accordée aux personnes qui sont en mesure de travailler légalement au Canada au moment de postuler (par exemple, les citoyennes et citoyens ou les résidentes permanentes et résidents permanents du Canada). Les candidates et candidats doivent satisfaire aux exigences gouvernementales en matière de filtrage de sécurité. Le poste est ouvert aux personnes qui répondent à toutes les exigences essentielles énoncées ci-dessus et dont la candidature est reçue avant la date limite.
 Engagement d’EDC envers l’équité en matière d’emploi 
 EDC s’engage à favoriser l’équité en matière d’emploi et à constituer une main-d’œuvre diversifiée. Elle s’engage également à créer un environnement sûr et inclusif qui respecte les personnes de toutes les origines, aptitudes et compétences. Elle favorise une culture d’inclusion et d’appartenance où tout le monde a des chances égales de se perfectionner, de se développer, de réussir et de réaliser son plein potentiel. 
 EDC invite les femmes, les Autochtones, les membres d’une minorité visible, les personnes en situation de handicap et les membres de la communauté 2ELGBTQI+ à poser leur candidature. 
 Votre candidature doit démontrer clairement que vous répondez à toutes les exigences. Nous remercions l’ensemble des candidates et candidats de leur intérêt pour une carrière à EDC. Toutefois, nous communiquerons uniquement avec les personnes retenues pour une entrevue de sélection. Veuillez noter que les candidates et les candidats qualifiés peuvent être pris en considération pour pourvoir d’autres postes du même niveau à EDC.

Sachez qu’en tant que Société, nous nous engageons à respecter la confidentialité et à veiller à ce que toutes les mesures d’adaptation fournies soient adaptées à vos besoins. Notre objectif est de vous garantir une expérience positive et satisfaisante tout au long du processus de recrutement. N’hésitez donc pas à nous contacter directement pour toute demande d’adaptation à l’adresse accessibility@edc.ca . Nous sommes là pour vous aider à chaque étape du processus. 
 Énoncé de confidentialité 
 En postulant à cet emploi, vous reconnaissez avoir lu et compris l'Énoncé de confidentialité d’EDC pour les candidats à l’emploi , qui décrit comment nous recueillons, utilisons, conservons et protégeons les renseignements personnels pendant le processus de recrutement, ainsi que vos droits d’accès et de rectification.

Le Travail
Le Directeur régional adjoint Bilingue soutient la croissance du volume d’origination du groupe financement immobilier en identifiant, structurant et analysant de nouvelles opportunités de financement. Avec l’appui du Vice-président régional, Québec, il entretient, développe et consolide les relations avec les partenaires, courtiers et clients directs, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes de crédit et de légal afin d’assurer le bon déroulement des dossiers et le respect des échéanciers. 
Le titulaire analyse et structure de nouvelles opportunités de prêts dans diverses catégories d’actifs immobiliers, évalue leur viabilité conformément aux paramètres de prêt et de tarification de la Banque, puis formule des recommandations au vice-président régional. 
Il participe à l’origination de transactions hypothécaires commerciales de plus de 10 M$, provenant de diverses sources de référence. Il prépare également les lettres d’intérêt (LOI), les accusés de réception des conditions (AOT), les résumés de crédit et effectue des visites de sites. Ce poste comporte de nombreux défis interfonctionnels et joue un rôle clé dans l’atteinte des objectifs annuels de volume d’origination du groupe financement immobilier. 
 
The Work
The Bilingual Associate Regional Director will support CFG origination volume growth by originating and analyzing new loan opportunities. With assistance from the Vice President & Managing Director, the Associate Regional Director will maintain, build and develop new partner, broker and direct relationships while working in collaboration with the credit and funding teams to ensure that the loan moves through the pipeline and meets timelines.   
The Associate Regional Director will analyze and structure new loan opportunities in a variety of asset classes and assess their viability in accordance with Equitable’s lending and pricing parameters, while making recommendations to the Managing Director.  
The Associate Regional Director will assist with originating commercial mortgage transactions greater than $5,000,000 sourced from various relationships. The Associate Regional Director will also issue Letters of Interest (LOI) and Acknowledgment of Terms (AOT), prepare loan summaries, and complete site inspections. This position involves cross-functional challenges and is integral to the overall success of the commercial group and BES in meeting annual origination volume targets. 

Les éléments essentiels de votre rôle seraient: : Avec le soutien du Vice-président régional, Québec, identifier, analyser et structurer de nouvelles opportunités de financement dans les différentes catégories d’actifs immobiliers commerciaux, tout en s’assurant que les transactions respectent les lignes directrices de crédit, les exigences de rendement sur capitaux propres (ROE), ainsi que les politiques et procédures de la Banque. 
 Lorsque requis selon l’exposition globale de l’emprunteur ou la catégorie d’actif, préparer le résumé de crédit avant l’émission d’une lettre d’intérêt (LOI) ou d’un accusé de réception des conditions (AOT), aux fins d’examen par le Vice-président régional, Québec et de présentation à la haute direction du crédit. 
 Promouvoir la marque d’Equitable Bank et du groupe de financement immobilier sur le marché en participant à des événements de l’industrie et des courtiers, tout en agissant comme ambassadeur auprès des courtiers, partenaires et clients. 
 Communiquer quotidiennement avec les équipes de crédit et de légal. 
 Gérer efficacement son pipeline de prêts afin de respecter les délais établis, en collaboration avec les équipes de crédit et de légal. 
 Effectuer des déplacements pour participer à des événements de l’industrie, rencontrer des clients ou réaliser des inspections de propriétés. 
 The core parts of your role would be to: 
 With support from the Vice President & Managing Director, the Associate Regional Director will originate, analyze, and structure new loan opportunities across the commercial real estate asset classes while ensuring that transactions are within the Bank’s established lending guidelines, ROE requirements, and policies and procedures. 
 When required by borrower aggregate or asset class, the Associate Regional Director will prepare the loan summary in advance of LOI or AOT issuance for review by the Vice President & Managing Director and presentation to senior credit management. 
 The Associate Regional Director will help promote the Equitable Bank and CFG brands in the market by attending broker and industry events, while being a customer advocate for brokers, partners, and clients. 
 The Associate Regional Director will communicate daily with the Commercial Originations team, and the credit and funding teams.

About us  
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.  
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.  
 But we don’t stop there.  
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.   
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.  
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.  
 What this role entails 
 The Client Success Partner (CSP) is one of the most strategically important client-facing roles at Fenergo. The CSP owns the post-sale relationship outright — retention, adoption, value realisation and growth — and is judged on whether clients keep getting measurable ROI long after go-live, not just at it. The CSP gets alongside the client — in the room, on the hardest problems — because that proximity is where the most valuable work and the sharpest IP are made.  
 Operating that close demands real depth: the Fenergo client lifecycle, the regulatory terrain we work in — KYC, AML, CLM, client lifecycle management, financial crime, risk — and how every team in the firm actually works. The CSP is the person a client’s executives call for a straight answer, and the person inside Fenergo who can get any door opened. 
 Because that depth is hard to hire and easy to grow, the CSP role is first and foremost an internal mobility path. We look for it in people who are already client-facing, product-fluent and trusted internally — Product, Advisory, Client Solutions, Delivery — and move them into partnership.  
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Be the Trusted Partner 
 Own the relationship. Own the post-sale success of a portfolio of clients. Each client has a live success plan tied to a named business outcome and ROI — not a status tracker.

 I. Scope and Summary of Primary Responsibilities 
 This position covers a broad range of duties and responsibilities including instructing individuals with vision loss on orientation and mobility which aid in the acquisition of movement skills and the concept development of spatial orientation, and environmental analysis related to independent travel by individuals who are visually impaired.
 II. Essential Functions 
 This position entails, but is not limited to the following general responsibilities: 
 ·       Conducts assessments and documents the O&M needs and personal goals of individuals with vision loss.
 ·       With the individual, identifies and prioritizes goals and develops an orientation & mobility service plan.
 ·       Teaches concept development, spatial and sensory awareness, pre-cane skills, cane techniques, and travel skills.
 ·       Encourages and provides support in assertiveness/advocacy skills to individuals as it relates to orientation and mobility.
 ·       Provides information and lessons in the use of electronic travel aids.
 ·       Provides tactile maps as required.
 ·       Teaches sighted guide to family members and others.
 ·       Acts as a resource person for information regarding guide dog schools. Provide skill development to prepare individuals to work with a guide dog. Works with guide dog schools as required.
 ·       Acts as a resource in matters related to accessible design and the built environment.
 ·       Maintains all case data and documentation consistent with VLRC Systems and Procedures.
 ·       Performs administrative duties including but not limited to service tracking, benchmarking, report writing, etc.
 ·       Other duties as assigned.
 Relationships 
 ·       Liaises and builds relationships with community-based rehabilitation teams, agencies, schools, partners and stakeholders.
 ·       Provides support and consultation to individuals and their families re: adjustment to vision loss.
 ·       Attends and participates in multi-disciplinary team meetings.
 ·       Promotes an understanding and awareness of vision health related issues through consultation, public education and in-service training.
 ·       Assists with the training, placement and supervision of volunteers and students.
 Problem Solving/Time Frame of Impact 
 ·       Provide timely delivery of orientation & mobility lessons to ensure individuals with vision loss acquire travel skills to remain/regain independence.
 ·       Ability to creatively and quickly problem solve to respond to unique individual needs. 
 Decision Autonomy 
 ·       Utilizes standard procedures and processes to work with individuals on developing an individual program to accommodate their unique needs.
 ·       Utilizes judgment when determining if the individual requires referral to another CNIB service or external services. 
 Leadership 
 ·       Takes initiative to keep abreast of new electronic travel aids and other advances/technologies and techniques in Orientation and mobility.
 ·       Takes initiative to be knowledgeable of guide dog schools and their programs.
 ·       Provides leadership to community groups and partners by educating, advocating and promoting awareness about vision loss.
 ·       Provides mentorship supervision to apprentice staff within the organization, leadership in training and coaching volunteers, students and staff.
 ·       Facilitate and enhance team efforts on a professional level and share specialized knowledge, sources, experience, concepts, and skills. 
 III. Qualifications 
 Knowledge and Skill Requirements 
 ·       Knowledge and experience working with individuals with vision loss.
 ·       Knowledgeable about disabilities and all life stages (children to seniors).
 ·       Well developed interpersonal and communications skills.
 ·       Decision-making and problem-solving ability.
 ·       Mature and professional attitude.
 ·       Self-directed, organized and detail oriented.
 ·       Demonstrated client centred approach and commitment. 
 ·       Adherence to professional of healthcare documentation, charting, and reporting.
 Experience and Education 
 ·       Graduate of the Instructor for Blind and Visually Impaired Program (Mohawk College); or Diploma in Specialized Studies, O&M and Vision Rehabilitation (University of Montreal).
 ·       Undergraduate degree or equivalent.
 ·       ACVREP Certified Orientation & Mobility Specialist (COMS) certification.
 ·       Good command of relevant computer applications.
 ·       Excellent verbal and written communications skills.
 Work Environment 
 ·       Service will be provided in office centers, individual homes and/or the community.
 ·       Willingness to work flexible hours. 
 Travel will be required

Physiotherapist – Community Care
 Casual | Employee or Independent Contractor | Flexible Scheduling | Toronto/GTA Area 
 The Care Company is a home healthcare organization dedicated to creating A Better Life for Those at Home . We support clients of all ages to live safely, independently, and with dignity in the comfort of their own homes. Our mission is to help people Make Each Day Count by delivering exceptional, person-centred care that puts people first and strives to be Better Today than we were yesterday.
 We are seeking a passionate and experienced Physiotherapist (PT) to join our growing community rehabilitation team. This role is ideal for a Physiotherapist who enjoys the autonomy of managing their own community caseload while being supported by an experienced interdisciplinary team.
 This is a flexible, casual opportunity that can be structured as either an employee or independent contractor position , depending on the successful candidate's preference. Whether you are looking to supplement an existing caseload, build your community practice, transition into home care, or simply enjoy the flexibility of accepting referrals that fit your schedule, we would love to hear from you.
 You will work closely with clients and their families in the home, completing comprehensive assessments, developing individualized treatment plans, and implementing evidence-based interventions that improve mobility, strength, balance, endurance, and overall function. Many of the individuals we support are living with complex or chronic medical conditions and require Alternate Level of Care (ALC) services.
 This is an exciting opportunity to join The Care Company as we continue to build and expand our Physiotherapy program. We are looking for therapists with an entrepreneurial mindset who are excited to help shape the future of community rehabilitation. Beyond delivering exceptional clinical care, there will be opportunities to contribute to new service development, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), quality improvement initiatives, and innovative models of care that can help expand Physiotherapy services across the community.
 As our PT program continues to evolve, there will also be mentorship and leadership opportunities for therapists interested in helping shape the future of community Physiotherapy. This includes opportunities to mentor Physiotherapy students during community placements, support the development of future clinicians, assist with onboarding new therapists, and contribute to clinical resources and best practices.
 Who This Role Is Perfect For
 This opportunity may be a great fit if you are:
 A Physiotherapist looking to supplement your existing caseload or private practice. 
 Interested in working as either an employee or independent contractor. 
 Looking for greater flexibility and autonomy over your schedule. 
 Passionate about helping clients remain mobile, safe, and independent in their homes. 
 Interested in mentorship, leadership, and supporting future Physiotherapists. 
 Entrepreneurial-minded and excited by the opportunity to help build and grow an evolving community rehabilitation program. 
 Comfortable working independently while knowing clinical and operational support is always available when needed. 
 What You'll Do
 As a Physiotherapist with The Care Company, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in clients' lives while enjoying the autonomy and flexibility of community practice. Working collaboratively with an interdisciplinary team, you will:
 Complete comprehensive in-home physiotherapy assessments within the required referral timeframe, including mobility assessments, balance evaluations, gait analysis, falls risk assessments, range of motion, strength testing, pain assessments, and functional mobility evaluations. 
 Develop individualized, evidence-based treatment plans that maximize mobility, independence, safety, and quality of life. 
 Provide follow-up visits focused on therapeutic exercise, gait training, balance retraining, mobility progression, pain management, post-operative rehabilitation, neurological rehabilitation, cardiorespiratory rehabilitation, and falls prevention. 
 Develop individualized home exercise programs and educate clients and caregivers to promote long-term success outside of treatment sessions. 
 Recommend and train clients in the safe use of mobility aids, gait aids, and assistive devices while collaborating with Occupational Therapists regarding equipment and home safety recommendations. 
 Support clients and families through education, coaching, and practical strategies that promote confidence, independence, and successful aging in place. 
 Collaborate closely with Occupational Therapists, nurses, Personal Support Workers, physicians, care coordinators, case managers, and Ontario Health atHome to support seamless care transitions. 
 Monitor client outcomes and modify treatment plans to ensure meaningful, measurable progress toward each client's rehabilitation goals. 
 Maintain accurate, timely, and clinically sound documentation. 
 Communicate proactively with the office regarding caseload availability, scheduling changes, urgent referrals, and client progress. 
 Independently manage your caseload and schedule while receiving administrative, scheduling, clinical, and technical support from The Care Company. 
 Deliver compassionate, ethical, and evidence-informed care while upholding The Care Company's commitment to clinical excellence. 
 Beyond Clinical Care
 This role offers more than a traditional community caseload. As The Care Company continues to expand its Physiotherapy services, you may also have opportunities to:
 Help shape and grow our community Physiotherapy program. 
 Contribute to new service development and Requests for Proposals (RFPs). 
 Participate in quality improvement initiatives and innovative models of community rehabilitation. 
 Mentor Physiotherapy students during community placements and help develop the next generation of Physiotherapists. 
 Support the onboarding and mentorship of future Physiotherapists joining the organization. 
 Collaborate with leadership on the development of clinical resources, treatment pathways, and best practices. 
 Grow into future clinical leadership and mentorship opportunities as our rehabilitation program continues to expand. 
 Scheduling
 Flexible, casual scheduling with no fixed weekly schedule. 
 Accept referrals based on your availability and geographic preference. 
 Initial in-person home assessments are generally expected within 48–72 hours of receiving a referral within your geographic service area. 
 Ability to independently manage scheduling and communicate promptly with the office regarding availability. 
 Travel between client homes is required; access to a reliable vehicle is considered an asset.
 Qualifications and Experience
 Registered and in good standing with the College of Physiotherapists of Ontario (CPO) . 
 Experience providing home and community care, particularly with HCCSS and/or Ontario Health atHome clients , is strongly preferred. 
 Community physiotherapy experience and/or hospital discharge, rehabilitation, or transitional care experience will also be considered. 
 Demonstrated skill in mobility assessments, falls prevention, gait training, balance retraining, therapeutic exercise prescription, neurological rehabilitation, orthopedic rehabilitation, and post-operative rehabilitation. 
 Experience prescribing mobility aids and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams. 
 Strong understanding of community discharge planning, mobility supports, caregiver education, and promoting aging in place. 
 Strong electronic documentation skills. 
 Experience coordinating with interdisciplinary teams and communicating with physicians and case managers. 
 Ability to work independently in the community and produce clear, timely, clinically appropriate documentation. 
 Valid driver's licence and access to reliable transportation, or the ability to travel efficiently within the designated service area. 
 Compensation
 $140 per initial assessment , including completion of the physiotherapy assessment, development of an individualized treatment plan, and any required funding applications or recommendations. 
 $75 per in-person follow-up visit. 
 $50 per virtual follow-up visit. 
 $25 per 30 minutes of approved administrative time completed outside of scheduled client visits, including documentation, care coordination, report writing, communication with physicians and interdisciplinary team members, development of home exercise programs, funding applications, equipment recommendations, and other client-related administrative duties. 
 We believe Physiotherapists should be fully compensated for the work they perform beyond direct client visits, recognizing that excellent community rehabilitation extends well beyond face-to-face treatment time.
 Why Join The Care Company? 
 Choose the engagement model that works best for you – opportunities may be available as either an employee or an independent contractor.
 Flexible, casual scheduling – accept referrals based on your availability without being tied to a fixed weekly schedule.
 Autonomy to build and manage your own community caseload while being supported by an experienced interdisciplinary team.
 Competitive compensation, including paid administrative time for work completed outside of direct client visits.
 Help build something meaningful – play an active role in shaping and expanding The Care Company’s Physical Therapy program.
 Opportunities to contribute to RFPs, new programs, quality improvement initiatives, and innovative models of community rehabilitation.
 Mentorship opportunities with Physical Therapy students and future clinicians.
 Opportunities for future clinical leadership and program development.
 24/7 clinical support from experienced clinical leadership whenever guidance is needed.
 24/7 technical support for documentation and technology-related questions.
 Educational training and ongoing professional development opportunities.
 PPE provided.
 Visits scheduled to minimize travel time and maximize efficiency.
 Mileage reimbursement at $0.55/km for approved travel exceeding 50 km between client visits. Travel from home to the first client and from the last client back home is considered part of the regular commute and is not reimbursed.
 Employee Recognition Program.
 Health and Wellness Program.
 Staff and service provider appreciation events.
 Opportunity to participate in Group Health and Dental Benefits, where applicable.
 If you are looking for an opportunity where you can make a meaningful impact, enjoy genuine flexibility and autonomy, and help shape the future of community Physical Therapy, we would love to hear from you.
 While we thank all applicants for their interest, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call . As a Senior Analytical Engineer, you sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you own the data foundations for a business domain end to end. Your mandate is to turn raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets that PMs, analysts, data scientists, and leaders actually trust and use — and to define the business logic and metric standards that make AI-powered self-serve trustworthy. You consume governed Silver tables and produce the Gold layer and semantic layer beneath Asana's most important metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces. 
 This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule . The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday .  What you’ll achieve 
 Own the Gold layer for a given business domain (e.g., PLG funnel, marketing attribution, revenue, NPI/AWM): Design and continuously improve the curated, dimensional data models that downstream dashboards, Genie spaces, and ELT reporting depend on.
 Implement the canonical business logic behind your domain's core KPIs: Translate KPIs into governed, versioned metric marts that resolve "this number doesn't match" disputes for good.
 Build and curate the semantic layer and Genie spaces that power self-serve in your domain: Author the metadata, documentation, and prompt/metric definitions that let stakeholders query governed data in plain language through Claude and Databricks Genie.

Nous faisons partie des 5 plus grands acteurs mondiaux dans les essentiels d’activewear, sommes le leader mondial du vêtement sans couture, et l’un des principaux fabricants de bas au Canada.
 En tant que guichet unique, nous travaillons avec innovation et passion afin d’offrir une qualité exceptionnelle et une grande valeur ajoutée à une clientèle internationale diversifiée. Notre succès repose sur notre expertise en technologies de tissus de performance, notre capacité d’innovation produit, nos investissements en excellence manufacturière, notre rapidité d’exécution, ainsi que la performance de notre chaîne d’approvisionnement, nous permettant de bâtir des partenariats solides, durables et significatifs à travers plusieurs réseaux de distribution.
 OBJECTIF DU POSTE 
 Le rôle principal consiste à soutenir les stratégies d’approvisionnement, assurer l’exactitude des coûts des vêtements et participer à l’exécution du développement de produits. Ce poste fait le lien entre les équipes commerciales, de design, de production, de qualité, de conformité, de logistique et les fournisseurs étrangers afin de garantir que les produits respectent les exigences de qualité, de coût et de délais, tout en préservant l’intégrité du client/de la marque.
 PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS 
 1. Approvisionnement et gestion des fournisseurs 
 Rechercher et évaluer des fournisseurs/fabricants de tissus tissés, de tricots et d’articles vestimentaires en fonction des exigences des acheteurs
 Gérer l’ensemble du cycle d’approvisionnement : identification des fournisseurs, développement, suivi de production et livraison dans les délais
 Coordonner les activités d’approvisionnement avec les fournisseurs assignés, en alignement avec les plans annuels et saisonniers
 Effectuer des évaluations régulières des fournisseurs sur la qualité, la capacité, la conformité et les prix
 Contribuer à la prévision des tendances et à la recherche de tissus
 2. Établissement des coûts et analyse commerciale 
 Préparer, examiner et valider des fiches de coûts détaillées pour les vêtements (tissus, fournitures, confection (cut & make), frais généraux)
 Analyser la consommation de tissu, les rendements, le coût des fournitures et les structures de marge
 Comparer les prix des fournisseurs entre différentes régions et unités de production
 Mener les négociations de coûts avec les filatures, fournisseurs de fournitures et partenaires manufacturiers
 Identifier les risques de dérive des coûts et piloter des initiatives d’optimisation saisonnière
 Maintenir des bases de données de coûts et des tableaux de suivi, et fournir des analyses d’écarts entre coûts estimés et réels
 3. Développement de produit 
 Gérer de bout en bout les activités de développement produit liées aux tissus, fournitures et échantillons
 Assurer le suivi de l’avancement des projets
 Fournir une visibilité précoce des coûts lors de la conception et du choix des matériaux
 Suggérer des matériaux ou méthodes de construction alternatives pour améliorer l’efficacité des coûts
 Gérer le développement produit, incluant l’échantillonnage et les négociations de prix
 Mettre en œuvre des initiatives d’amélioration continue et identifier des opportunités d’économies
 EXIGENCES 
 Compétences techniques 
 Bonne compréhension des tissus (tricotés et tissés), des fils, des constructions et des finitions
 Connaissance des élastiques, fournitures, étiquetage et procédés d’ornementation
 Solide compréhension de la construction des vêtements, des types de tissus, des fournitures, des techniques de teinture et d’impression et des processus de production
 Forte capacité analytique et intuition en matière de coûts
 Maîtrise d’Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, modèles de coûts, analyse de données, suivi de projets de développement)
