 Excellente communication avec des fournisseurs à l’international
 Esprit analytique orienté coûts
 Autonomie et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément
 Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement rapide et en forte croissance
 Attitude proactive, curiosité et débrouillardise

 Family-owned since 1953, Lamour Inc. has earned a reputation for being the best choice in socks, performance apparel, hosiery and lingerie. In fact, we're among the world's top 5 players in activewear basics, the world's leading manufacturer of seamless garments, and one of Canada's leading sock manufacturers. 
 As a one-stop shop, we work innovatively and passionately to deliver exceptional quality and value to a diverse international customer base. It's our focus on performance fabric technology and product innovation, investment in manufacturing excellence, speed-to-market and supply chain execution that enables us to build meaningful, strong and sustainable retail partnerships across multiple trade channels.
 ROLE PURPOSE 
 Primary role consists of assisting in sourcing strategies, garment costing accuracy, and product development execution. This role bridges commercial, design, production, quality, compliance, logistics and overseas vendors to ensure products meet quality, cost, and timeline expectations while maintaining customer/brand integrity.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Sourcing & Vendor Management 
 Source and evaluate suppliers/manufacturers for woven, knitwear, and apparel based on buyer requirements
 Manage end-to-end sourcing cycle: vendor identification, development, production follow-up, and timely delivery
 Coordinate sourcing activities with assigned suppliers aligned with annual and seasonal supply plans
 Conduct regular vendor evaluations on quality, capacity, compliance, and pricing
 Assist in trend forecasting and fabric sourcing
 2. Costing & Commercial Analysis 
 Prepare, review, and validate detailed garment cost sheets including fabric, trims, CM (Cut & Make), and overheads
 Able to analyze fabric consumption, yield calculations, trim costing, and margin structures
 Benchmark vendor pricing across regions and production units
 Lead cost negotiations with fabric mills, trim suppliers, and manufacturing partners
 Identify cost leakage risks and drive seasonal cost optimization initiatives
 Maintain cost databases and tracking dashboards; provide variance analysis between estimated vs. actual costs
 3. Product Development 
 End-to-end product development activities related to fabrics, trims, samples 
 Tracking of project status and follow up
 Provide early-stage cost visibility during design and material selection
 Suggest alternative materials or construction methods for cost efficiency
 Manage product development including sampling, price negotiations
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives and identify cost-saving opportunities
 Requirements: 
 Technical Skills 
 Understanding of fabrics (knit and woven), yarns, construction, finishes.
 Knowledge of elastics, trims, labeling, and embellishment processes.
 Strong understanding of garment construction, fabric types, trims, dyeing, printing techniques, production processes 
 Strong costing intuition & analytical ability.
 Excel proficiency (pivot tables, costing models, data analysis, development project tracking).
 Familiarity with PLM/ERP systems (Blue Cherry is an asset).
 Proven supplier negotiation experience; experience with international sourcing 
 Soft Skills 
 Highly organized and structured
 Persistent in supplier follow-up
 Strong communicator with overseas vendors
 Analytical thinking in costing
 Able to work independently, juggle many developments
 Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
 Proactive, curious, and resourceful

About the role and team 
Uber Maps Search helps people find the places and destinations they need across Uber experiences. The multi-disciplinary team builds the backend systems, deep learning models & user experience components behind location search - from understanding a query and retrieving relevant places to serving useful results with the speed and reliability people expect. Because location search is the 1-step of any Go-Get experience at Uber, the team's contributions meaningfully influence Uber's business performance, and the team's work is highly visible to the executive leadership team.
As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll set technical direction for important, multi-quarter initiatives and help evolve the services and data foundations that power search. You'll partner closely with machine learning, science, mobile, and other engineering teams to turn customer and business needs into scalable systems. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you'll shape architecture, guide delivery across teams, and raise the quality and reliability of the platform.
 What you'll do 
 Lead the architecture and end-to-end delivery of high-impact Maps Search projects, from problem definition and technical strategy through launch and ongoing operation.
 Design, build, and evolve scalable backend services for location search, including query handling, autocomplete, retrieval, result aggregation, and recommendation-serving workflows.
 Improve the latency, availability, relevance, and operational health of high-throughput search systems, using data and production signals to identify and address bottlenecks.
 Build and maintain dependable data pipelines and serving infrastructure that bring search and machine-learning capabilities into production.
 Make thoughtful system-level tradeoffs across service boundaries, data freshness, quality, cost, and reliability; communicate decisions and establish durable technical direction.
 Partner with product, machine learning, science, mobile, and infrastructure teams to define goals, align dependencies, and deliver cohesive customer experiences.
 Raise the technical bar through design and code reviews, practical engineering standards, and hands-on mentorship of engineers across the organization.
 Strengthen operational excellence through observability, incident follow-up, capacity planning, and improvements to on-call health.
 Basic Qualifications 
 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating backend services or distributed systems.
 Strong programming skills in at least one backend language, such as Java, Go, C++, or Python.
 Demonstrated technical leadership on complex, cross-team projects, including setting architecture and driving delivery from conception to production.
 Experience designing systems for scale, reliability, and low latency, and diagnosing issues in production environments.
 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, API design, and system design.
 Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and work effectively with engineering and non-engineering partners.
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience building search, information retrieval, ranking, recommendation, or geospatial products.
 Experience with high-QPS, latency-sensitive consumer-facing systems and distributed service architectures.
 Experience building data pipelines, indexes, or online serving systems for machine-learning-powered products.
 Familiarity with search relevance, query understanding, personalization, semantic search, or multi-source retrieval.
 Experience improving production reliability, observability, and operational practices for critical services.
 A track record of influencing technical direction across teams and mentoring senior engineers.
 Graduate degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
